visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a well-lit modern living room. In the background, a large traditional floral painting hangs on the wall. A small orange and white tabby cat walks across the floor from the left. (2) The camera angle shifts to a medium close-up of the woman. The cat jumps onto the sofa and begins to climb around her shoulders and back. The woman continues to look at her phone, though she occasionally adjusts her posture. The lighting is soft and even throughout the room. (3) The cat settles onto the woman's lap. She eventually places her smartphone on the glass coffee table in front of her. She begins to pet the cat with both hands, stroking its head and neck while smiling warmly. The cat appears relaxed and closes its eyes. (4) The scene cuts to a different angle of the same living room, now featuring an older man with glasses wearing a purple vest over a gray long-sleeved shirt. He is sitting on the sofa, eating an apple. The cat is standing on the floor near a black decorative side table. (5) The cat jumps into the black mesh basket and then onto the man's lap. The man continues to eat his apple, looking down at the cat but maintaining his focus on his food. He occasionally looks toward the camera while chewing. The cat remains on his lap, looking around the room.
